title: Reduce stale role collisions in compact claim frontier
mission: Investigate and repair why POOL PROD-01 could receive a compact claim-frontier roughly eleven minutes old whose compiled role_ready G000001 paths were already owned, forcing two deterministic CREATE_EXISTS races before the protocol-permitted stale refresh. Make the smallest compiler/publication/freshness change that suppresses already-owned role candidates or refreshes the compact frontier promptly enough to avoid repeated stale role collisions, without adding worker preclaim archaeology, weakening atomic PIN authority, increasing the three-attempt budget, or hiding specialized work.
definition_of_done: Reproduce a fixture where claim-frontier generated_at is stale and two published role_ready candidates already have their exact immutable G000001 role PINs.
Identify whether lag comes from compiler trigger cadence, gh-pages publication cadence, stale role suppression, or another explicit mechanism; record the exact cause.
Patch the smallest central compiler/publication rule so the same state no longer burns two worker authority attempts before a fresh claimable role appears.
Preserve atomic create-if-absent authority, the one-refresh-after-two-collisions law, capability filtering, deterministic POOL sharding, and the ordinary preclaim read budget.
Do not suppress specialized browser/mobile/host work merely because a generic worker cannot execute it.
Add bounded regression coverage for stale role candidates plus a fresh compatible successor and run the relevant allocator/ratchet checks when the runtime permits.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion.
